children: Ascend Wellness Holdings agreed to acquire an Ohio cultivation facility and one dispensary for part of a $35.5 million asset purchase covering five dispensaries.
The total stated consideration is $35.5 million in cash, payable through an upfront deposit and installments tied to management agreements, closing, and post-closing dates.
Ascend’s subsidiary agreed to acquire the cultivation facility and one Akron dispensary; a third-party retail buyer agreed to acquire the other four dispensaries.
The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions, including required regulatory approvals.
